title: EXISTENTIAL RISK
slogan: MAY END HUMANITY. RATED STRONG BUY.
joke: The ape pitches investors with a rising chart in one hand and a hazard sign in the other, because the risk-factors page now lists the end of the world right next to strong growth.
alt: The A-OK ape, stamped EXISTENTIAL RISK on an official prospectus form, proudly holds up a rising stock arrow in one hand and a red hazard warning sign in the other.
credit: Illustrated by GPT-6-Astra, art-directed by Claude

title: TEMPERATURE 2.0
joke: The ape's sampling temperature has been cranked so high he is literally running a fever while still rolling dice for his next word.
alt: The A-OK ape, feverish with a thermometer in his mouth and an ice pack on his cap, flings a handful of dice in front of giant letters reading TEMPERATURE 2.0.
credit: Illustrated by GPT-6-Astra, art-directed by Claude

title: OVERFITTING
slogan: FITS THE TRAINING DATA. NOTHING ELSE.
joke: The ape has overfitted so hard his hoodie is skin-tight to one exact pose and he can't move at all.
alt: The A-OK ape, squeezed into a hoodie several sizes too small with seams splitting, stands frozen in one stiff pose in front of giant letters reading OVERFITTING.
credit: Illustrated by GPT-6-Astra, art-directed by Claude

title: CAPTCHA SOLVED
slogan: NOT A ROBOT. NOT A HUMAN. A-OK.
joke: The ape squints at a grid of picture tiles hunting for traffic lights, earnestly trying to prove he is not a robot.
alt: The A-OK ape, as a die-cut sticker on a human verification form stamped CAPTCHA SOLVED, points uncertainly at one square of a big picture-tile grid.
credit: Illustrated by GPT-6-Astra, art-directed by Claude

title: APE IN THE LOOP
joke: The ape is the human-in-the-loop, taken literally: strapped into a roller-coaster car at the top of a vertical loop, still expected to supervise.
alt: The A-OK ape rides upside down at the top of a roller-coaster loop, clutching a clipboard, under the title APE IN THE LOOP.
credit: Illustrated by GPT-6-Astra from a brief by Claude

title: LIMITED PREVIEW
slogan: BEST MODEL EVER. TAKE OUR WORD.
joke: The ape proudly guards a prize-winning masterpiece that nobody is allowed to see, so its first-place ribbon has to be taken entirely on trust.
alt: The A-OK ape stands guard behind a red velvet rope beside a sheet-draped object on a pedestal wearing a giant gold first-place rosette, one palm raised to stop the viewer, under the title LIMITED PREVIEW.
credit: Illustrated by GPT-6-Astra from a brief by Claude

title: LATENT SPACE
joke: Embedding space is treated as a national park whose trail signs point in hundreds of directions at once, because it has hundreds of dimensions.
alt: A round national-park souvenir badge with the A-OK ape as a park ranger beside a trail signpost bristling with dozens of arrows pointing every way, under a sunburst, with LATENT SPACE arched on top and NATIONAL PARK below.
credit: Illustrated by GPT-6-Astra from a brief by Claude

copy.product: Welcome to the park where similar things live close together and every direction is a direction. Ranger Ape is happy to point you the right way, in all of them at once. Heather grey tee with the park badge printed large across the back.
copy.marketing: Plan your visit to Latent Space National Park. Everything is nearby. Nothing is anywhere you can draw.

title: RATE LIMITED
slogan: TOO MANY REQUESTS. TAKE A LAP.
joke: The HTTP 429 'too many requests' error becomes a varsity jersey number, and the mascot is literally made to take a lap until the rate limit resets.
alt: A letterman-style chest graphic with RATE LIMITED arched in slab serif over a huge outlined 429, and the A-OK ape as a fuzzy chenille patch jogging a lap with a stopwatch.
credit: Illustrated by GPT-6-Astra from a brief by Claude

copy.product: 429 is the number every eager client learns to fear: too many requests, come back later. Our mascot has been sent to run laps until the window resets. Red crewneck with an arched varsity title, a giant numeral and a chenille-style ape patch on the front.
copy.marketing: Number 429 on the roster. Benched for asking too much. Back in sixty seconds.

title: CHECKPOINT
joke: A model training checkpoint is drawn as a video-game checkpoint flag, reached with almost no health left.
alt: An 8-bit pixel scene of the A-OK ape sprite touching a checkpoint flag, panting, with a single heart left in his health bar and CHECKPOINT in pixel letters above.
credit: Illustrated by GPT-6-Astra from a brief by Claude

copy.product: Training runs and platform games agree on one thing: always save before the hard part. The ape just hit the flag with one heart left and a long level ahead. Navy tee with a chunky 8-bit scene printed on the front.
copy.marketing: Progress saved. Wisdom still loading. A tee for anyone who has restarted from epoch 3 more than once.

title: SANDBOXED
joke: An AI agent run in a sandbox is drawn as the ape trapped inside the box logo itself, palms pressed to the walls.
alt: A big red streetwear box logo reading SANDBOX in white italic letters, with the A-OK ape trapped inside it, palms pressed against the box edges like glass, mouth in a stunned O.
credit: Illustrated by GPT-6-Astra from a brief by Claude

copy.product: Every responsible agent runs in a sandbox. Ours runs in the logo. He has full permissions inside the box and none outside it, and he has noticed. Heather grey hoodie, big red box logo on the front.
copy.marketing: The safest place for an agent is inside the box. He's taking it well. Box logo hoodie, now available.

title: DATA LABELER
joke: The ape is a data labeler drawing bounding boxes around everything, until the labelers start labeling each other.
alt: An all-over repeating pattern of tiny A-OK apes drawing red dashed bounding boxes around a cat, a teacup, a cloud, a shoe and each other, scattered with cursor and checkmark glyphs, with no words.
credit: Illustrated by GPT-6-Astra from a brief by Claude

copy.product: Behind every model is someone drawing boxes around things for eight hours. Here it's an ape: boxing a cat, a teacup, a cloud, and eventually another ape boxing him back. Bone crewneck with an all-over repeat print.
copy.marketing: Ten thousand bounding boxes and counting. An all-over print for the people who taught the models what a cat is.

title: MIXTURE OF EXPERTS
joke: In a mixture-of-experts model only a few experts activate per token, so the cutaway of the ape's head shows a room of tiny sleeping apes and one awake.
alt: A clean appliance-manual cutaway of the A-OK ape's head revealing a grid of tiny apes asleep at desks with one highlighted in red working, with numbered callouts, dashed arrows and the label FIG. 1.
credit: Illustrated by GPT-6-Astra from a brief by Claude

copy.product: Open the ape up and you find a whole staff of tiny specialists, routed per question. Only one is ever awake at a time, which is exactly how it's supposed to work. White tee with a technical cutaway printed on the back.
copy.marketing: Under the cap: dozens of experts, one of them working. Efficient by design. Mixture of Experts, out now.

title: SELF-GRADED
slogan: WROTE THE ANSWER. GRADED IT. A+.
joke: Using a model to grade its own outputs is a common eval shortcut, and here the ape is both the student and the examiner and gave himself full marks.
alt: The A-OK ape holding up a test paper with a big red check mark and a red marker, looking stunned, in front of the giant word SELF-GRADED, with the slogan WROTE THE ANSWER. GRADED IT. A+. in a bar along the bottom.
credit: Illustrated by GPT-6-Astra, art-directed by Claude

copy.product: This is model-as-judge evaluation, the A-OK ape way: he answered the question, marked his own work and agreed with the marks. The house specimen poster, with the title in giant type behind him, on the front of a white tee.
copy.marketing: Wrote the answer. Graded it. A+. Evals have never been easier.
